lines.en: What is Debbie going to try to do?
Debbie Hart is going to swim
across the English Channel tomorrow.
She is going to set out from the French coast
at five o'clock in the morning.
Debbie is only eleven years old
and she hopes to set up a new world record.
lines.zh: 她希望能创造一个新的世界纪录。

lines.en: She is a strong swimmer and many people feel
lines.zh: 她是一名出色的游泳运动员，许多人觉得

lines.en: that she is sure to succeed.
Debbie's father will set out with her
lines.zh: 黛比的父亲将与她一起

lines.en: in a small boat.
Mr. Hart has trained his daughter for years.
lines.zh: 哈特先生训练他的女儿已经多年了。

lines.en: Tomorrow he will be watching her anxiously
lines.zh: 明天，他将焦急地看着她

lines.en: as she swims the long distance to England.
lines.zh: 游过那漫长的距离去英国。

lines.en: Debbie intends to take short rests every two hours.
lines.zh: 黛比打算每两小时短暂停歇一次。

lines.en: She will have something to drink
but she will not eat any solid food.
Most of Debbie's school friends will be
lines.zh: 黛比的大部分同学都将

lines.en: waiting for her on the English coast.
Among them will be Debbie's mother,
who swam the Channel herself
lines.zh: 她本人在还是个女孩的时候

lines.en: when she was a girl.
